national_museum.name: National Museum of Tanzania
national_museum.price_text: Small entry fee in TZS; confirm the current rate at the gate
national_museum.hours: Daily roughly 09:30–18:00; check on the day
national_museum.tip: Start with the human origins and slave trade galleries, then the rock art room.

askari_monument.name: Askari Monument
askari_monument.tip: A quick photo stop in the busy city centre; keep valuables close and cross with care.

kariakoo_market.name: Kariakoo Market
kariakoo_market.price_text: Free to enter; pay for what you buy
kariakoo_market.hours: Busy from early morning to late afternoon; quieter on Sunday
kariakoo_market.tip: Go early for fresh produce and spice stalls, and agree prices before buying.

kivukoni_fish_market.name: Kivukoni Fish Market
kivukoni_fish_market.hours: Most active early morning; check on the day
kivukoni_fish_market.tip: Arrive around dawn to see the catch come in, and watch your footing on wet floors.

village_museum.name: Village Museum (Makumbusho)
village_museum.price_text: Modest entry fee in TZS; check on the day
village_museum.hours: Roughly 09:30–18:00 daily; check on the day
village_museum.tip: Traditional houses from across Tanzania in one outdoor site; good for families.

coco_beach.name: Coco Beach
coco_beach.hours: Always open; liveliest late afternoon and evening
coco_beach.tip: Popular with locals for sunset; swimming is not always safe, so ask before going in.

kigamboni_ferry.name: Kigamboni Ferry crossing
kigamboni_ferry.price_text: Low fare in TZS per person; check on the day
kigamboni_ferry.hours: Runs through the day, roughly 05:00–23:00; check on the day
kigamboni_ferry.tip: A cheap short crossing with harbour views; go at sunset and keep bags zipped.

slipway.name: The Slipway waterfront
slipway.hours: Shops and restaurants roughly 10:00–23:00; check on the day
slipway.tip: Harbour-side restaurants and a small craft market; easy evening for first-timers.

mikadi_beach.name: Mikadi Beach
mikadi_beach.price_text: Small entry fee at some gates; check on the day
mikadi_beach.tip: Calm water and beach bars; a relaxed half-day near the peninsula.

oyster_bay_walk.name: Oyster Bay shoreline walk
oyster_bay_walk.tip: Walk the seafront path at sunset for open ocean views and sea breezes.

city_walk.name: City centre heritage walk
city_walk.price_text: Free self-guided; guided tours priced per group, check locally
city_walk.tip: Link the Askari Monument, old buildings and the harbour front on foot; go with a local guide if unsure of the route.

botanical_garden.name: Dar es Salaam Botanical Garden
botanical_garden.price_text: Free or small fee; check on the day
botanical_garden.tip: Shady green pause in the city centre; keep to busy paths.

st_joseph.name: St Joseph's Cathedral
st_joseph.hours: Open around services; check on the day
st_joseph.tip: Quiet colonial-era church near the centre; dress respectfully.

mbezi_sunset.name: Msasani sunset viewpoint
mbezi_sunset.tip: Find a spot along the peninsula shore for the harbour sunset.

boat_trip.name: Harbour and islands boat trip
boat_trip.price_text: Priced per boat or per person; agree the price first
boat_trip.hours: Daytime departures; check on the day
boat_trip.tip: Short boat trips leave from the harbour area; confirm safety gear and price before boarding.

nyama_choma.name: Nyama choma and local food spots
nyama_choma.price_text: Pay per plate; budget-friendly in TZS
nyama_choma.hours: Mainly lunch and evening; check on the day
nyama_choma.tip: Try grilled meat with ugali and kachumbari at busy local spots.

mikocheni_market.name: Mikocheni local market
mikocheni_market.price_text: Free to enter; pay for purchases
mikocheni_market.tip: Everyday market for fruit and snacks; carry small notes.

beach_resort_day.name: Beach day on the peninsula
beach_resort_day.price_text: Hotel day passes vary; check on the day
beach_resort_day.tip: Some hotels sell day passes for pool and beach; call ahead to confirm.

art_gallery.name: Local art and craft galleries
art_gallery.price_text: Free to browse; pay for purchases
art_gallery.tip: Tingatinga paintings and carvings make good souvenirs; agree prices politely.

seafood_dinner.name: Seafood dinner by the water
seafood_dinner.price_text: Pay per dish; mid to higher range in TZS
seafood_dinner.hours: Evening, roughly 18:00–23:00; check on the day
seafood_dinner.tip: Fresh fish and prawns along the peninsula; book ahead on weekends.
